status: Counterfactual analytic transformation of existing measurements; no additional wet-lab data
source_pairs: Nominal E2 R03 / E2 R01, no one-day retests
interpretation: Under a constant apparent E_eta Andrade null, the observed same-temperature E2 contrast corresponds to a temperature displacement much larger than a hypothetical 1–2 C bias. These displacements are not observed thermometer offsets and do not identify the molecular cause of the state variation.
